mathematics.assertion_tested: Lean kernel acceptance of actual p-adic polynomial local uniqueness, coefficient perturbation identities and congruences, and finite-precision root stability; inherited integer towers and p-adic existence; explicit statement contracts; rejection of invalid uniqueness and precision generalizations

Rank-nullity cardinality formulas over composite moduli
Full weighted perturbation theorem with rationally invertible Jacobian
Uniqueness of roots for rectangular surjective Jacobians

residual_risks: Uses the pinned Lean kernel and precompiled Mathlib dependencies with the listed standard axioms.
